NVIDIA is searching for several interns to join the Learning and Perception research team for an internship in the areas of embodied and agentic AI, such as perception, agentic reasoning, multi-modal and continual learning, AI scientists, and so on. We are passionate about research that pushes boundaries but also has impact in the real world. You will work within an amazing and collaborative research team that has a long history of publishing the results of internship projects at top venues in computer vision and machine learning. We have many experienced mentors in the team, and our interns often choose to return for another internship. We carefully craft internship projects such that they match the interns' expertise.

What you'll be doing:
Research, design, and implement novel embodied and agentic AI methods.
Work collaboratively with your mentor and a broader team of world-class researchers to develop your ideas from early hypothesis through rigorous experimentation.
Partner with product and engineering groups to transfer research breakthroughs into real-world applications
Rapidly prototype and iterate on ideas using state-of-the-art hardware and infrastructure.

What we need to see:
Must be pursuing a PhD in Computer Science/Engineering, Electrical Engineering, etc.
Excellent knowledge of theory and practice of AI, in particular in computer vision, LLMs, and agents.
Excellent programming skills in some rapid prototyping environment such as Python, C++.
Knowledge of common machine learning frameworks, such as PyTorch.
Promising research track record.
Excellent communications skills.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:
Knowledge in parallel programming (e.g., CUDA) is a plus.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers with competitive salaries and a generous benefits package. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our best-in-class engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a real passion for computer architecture and technology, we want to hear from you!
Our internship hourly rates are a standard pay based on the position, your location, year in school, degree, and experience. The hourly rate for our interns is 38 USD - 94 USD.
You will also be eligible for Intern benefits.
Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 6, 2026.
This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Job Details:
Job Description:
The Role and Impact

Are you interested in GPU and AI accelerator hardware and want hands-on experience designing and bringing new technology to life?

As a GPU & AI Accelerator Hardware Design Undergraduate Intern, you will work alongside experienced engineers developing next-generation GPU and AI accelerator platforms. You will gain practical experience across PCB and board design, power delivery, circuit design, simulation, board bring-up, validation, debugging, and automation.

This internship provides an opportunity to apply concepts learned through coursework, labs, research, and technical projects to real-world hardware challenges while collaborating with Intel's cross-functional engineering teams.

What You’ll Do
Depending on project and team needs, you mayhave the key responsibilities will include but not limited to:
Support GPU and AI accelerator board and power design from concept through bring-up and validation.
Assist with PCB schematic design, layout, component selection, and Bill of Materials (BOM) development.
Learn to troubleshoot challenges involving high-speed board, power, digital, and analog design.
Use engineering and simulation tools such as Cadence, Sigrity, SIMetrix, Mathcad, MATLAB, PowerDC, or similar tools.
Participate in board bring-up, characterization, validation, and hardware debug.
Use laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes and thermal measurement equipment and support soldering/rework activities.
Assist with evaluating power requirements and power-delivery solutions for GPU and AI accelerator designs.
Develop or improve test methods and use Python or other scripting languages to automate measurements and data collection.
Gain exposure to microcontroller and FPGA firmware design and debugging.
Collaborate with board, layout, thermal-mechanical, validation, firmware, software, and other engineering teams.
Research and evaluate technologies that can improve future hardware designs and engineering processes.
Behavioral traits that we are looking for:
Curiosity and learning agility: Eager to learn new technologies, tools, and hardware-design concepts.
Problem-solving: Uses a structured approach to investigate and troubleshoot technical issues.
Attention to detail: Carefully evaluates designs, measurements, and test results.
Collaboration: Works effectively with engineering partners across different disciplines.
Communication: Clearly shares technical observations, questions, and results.
Initiative: Takes ownership of assignments and proactively seeks guidance when needed.
Innovation mindset: Looks for opportunities to improve tools, designs, and processes.
Proactive mindset: Anticipates needs, identifies potential challenges early, and takes appropriate action without waiting to be asked.
Intel invests in our people and offers a complete and competitive package of benefits employees and their families through every stage of life.
Qualifications:
You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. Requirements listed would be obtained through a combination of industry relevant job experience, internship experiences and or schoolwork/classes/research.

Minimum Qualifications and Experience:
Candidate must be pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Mechatronics Engineering, or other relevant science/engineering related field.

Candidate must also have 3+ months of educational or work experience with the following:
Hardware design principles and PCB layout techniques.
Experience with board bring-up, debugging tools, and electrical measurements.
Design software such as Cadence, Altium, or similar tools.
AI acceleration hardware and computing architectures.
Preferred Qualifications and Experience:
Discrete graphics add-in cards or mobile discrete graphics systems.
Knowledge of current leading PC technology.
Familiar with PC x86 architecture and excellent system level knowledge including CPU processor, multimedia, memory, PCIe, display technologies, power management, 3D graphics.
Experience in building your own PC and computer hardware.
Programming skills in Python or similar languages.

Why Join Intel?
Help build the hardware powering the next generation of GPU and AI computing. You'll gain hands-on experience designing, bringing up, and validating advanced hardware while learning from engineers across board, power, thermal, firmware, and validation disciplines. You'll apply what you've learned in the classroom to real engineering challenges and develop skills that can help launch your career in hardware engineering.

Job Details:
Job Description:
The Role and Impact

Intel is seeking a highly motivated Software Research Intern (PhD) to join the TCAD Process Reliability Modeling team within Intel Foundry. This internship offers an opportunity to work on advanced computational software solutions supporting semiconductor technology development. The selected candidate will contribute to cutting-edge software applications and solution methodologies like chip-package interactions, thermal transport and thermal management, thin films development and patterning.

The internship is designed for PhD students interested in applying software engineering and research expertise to solve complex engineering challenges while collaborating with multidisciplinary teams across Intel.
Business Group

The Intel Foundry Technology organization is focused on driving semiconductor process innovation and enabling future technology nodes. Within the LTD-TD TCAD team, engineers and researchers develop advanced simulation, modeling, and software solutions used to accelerate technology development. The team fosters a collaborative environment where software, mathematics, physics, and engineering intersect to solve challenging technical problems.
Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and optimize software solutions for engineering and research applications.
Develop simulations capabilities using numerical methods like finite element, level sets, or related techniques.
Develop modeling-based methodologies to solve device and interconnect process, module and reliability problems.
Establish criteria and methods to determine proper inputs and validate results.
Collaborate with software engineers, researchers, and domain experts to deliver scalable and maintainable solutions.
Document technical solutions and present findings to project stakeholders.
Qualifications:
Minimum Qualifications

Must be a full-time student pursuing a Ph.D. degree in Electrical Engineering, Material Science, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering or a semiconductor-related field.
Must have a minimum of a 3.0 GPA in college courses to date.
1+ year experience programming in C/C++/Python or equivalent.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and software development skills.
Preferred Qualifications

Experience with using TCAD or atomistic simulation tools to study thermo-mechanical and chip/package interactions, thermal transport, thin film deposition processes, patterning, material chemical interactions or circuit performance.
Hands on experience development and/or using finite element or equivalent solvers for solutions of physical systems.
Experience with physics-based modeling, AI/machine learning methodologies for the analysis of solid mechanics, thermal management, reliability and manufacturing process of microprocessors devices.

This is your opportunity to develop your expertise, gain hands-on experience, and make a meaningful impact within a collaborative environment that drives the future of technology. We look forward to seeing how your skills and passion will contribute to our innovative team.
